items.summary: Fix the current win streak calculation in the ProfilePage so it counts consecutive wins from the most recent match backwards through match history, stopping (resetting to 0) as soon as a loss is encountered. The streak must be derived from win/loss match records, not from days played or availability data.

Fix the best (all-time) streak calculation in the ProfilePage `computeBestStreak` helper so it scans the full match history in chronological order, increments a running counter on each win, resets it to 0 on each loss, and returns the highest value the counter ever reached. This must use win/loss match records exclusively.
Fix the win streak calculation displayed on the LeaderboardPage so it also uses consecutive wins from match history (same logic as REQ-1 and REQ-2), not days played or availability counts.
